86 passed; real PNG16/LCMS through adapter, alpha precision, cancellation and scratch quotas. Full service integration not run.
6 focused tests pass, including actual ICC-bearing JPEG, alpha WebP and cross-language profile hash. Full platform regression: 287 passed.
Unit/platform suite and live PostgreSQL integration cover exact outbox intake, leased planning, four-variant task materialization, fenced canonical result adoption and derivative cache publication.

3 live PostgreSQL tests pass: accepted owner ingest auto-enqueues and adopts all four derivatives through canonical attempt/fence results; pending-review ingest remains gated; bulk repair remains replay-safe.

Migration00156 extends the exact-origin queue to Apply without weakening ingest/bulk provenance. A live pending→accepted Apply version enqueues, claims and begins a version-bound preview run; pending versions remain absent.

Live PostgreSQL starts two owner uploads concurrently at a 1500-byte/one-file quota. Exactly one 1000-byte reservation and one multipart begin succeed; counters remain 1000/1 and return to 0/0 after abort. Upload integration tests are now part of make test-db.

Live versioned MinIO plus disposable PostgreSQL cover failure before CompleteMultipart and loss of the response after successful completion. Retry/recovery produces exactly one artifact, snapshot, and ingest run, preserves the exact reservation, and terminal replay is a no-op. Migration00169 repairs an ambiguous tenant_usage reference discovered by this test.

14 focused tests reject forged magic/suffix MIME, SVG/spoof bytes, CMYK, multipage images, >200M-pixel dimensions/decompression-bomb declarations, missing ICC without an explicit assumption, bad hashes/sizes and malformed images before any output is staged.

decisions: Asset signature/size/hash/header and tiled raster decode verification implemented. Working decode preserves RGB16, alpha, performs orientation once, rejects CMYK/multipage and requires ICC or explicit assumption. RAW uses rawpy camera WB/AHD/linear sRGB; real camera corpus verification remains. Multipart/object gateway/upload services remain.

asset_operations now supplies asset.verify/media and asset.inspect/cpu executable adapters using TaskArtifacts. Strict VerifyParams/InspectParams contain declared source ref, expected bytes and allowed suffix. Outputs are VerifiedAsset or AssetMetadata JSON manifests with pinned source and ICC hash. Migration23 enables only verified/metadata output roles, max1MiB/count1. libvips alpha converted to bool; size/hash/decode loops support cancellation. Worker CLI, graph integration, SQL20–23 verification and other operations remain incomplete.

asset.decode CPU adapter now executable with explicit validated PHOTO_ICC_ROOT. Strict DecodeParams, task-scoped declared source, planned scratch names and private atomic publication, cancellation between tiles, immutable RGB float32/alpha uint16 NPY and WorkingImage manifest. Migration27 enables exact output roles; all binary refs returned for task attestation. SQL20–27, graph integration, RAW corpus/peak RAM and full E2E remain unverified/incomplete. Legacy source/preset SHA baseline unchanged.

media.thumbnail and media.preview are executable media-class adapters with fixed 320/640 and 1600/2560 profiles, no upscale, LittleCMS sRGB conversion, JPEG/WebP alpha behavior, embedded ICC, strict input binding and verified staged output. Migration96 limits output roles and sizes. Owner media-link API enforces tenant/project ACL, asset/version binding, current cross-language profile hash, ready exact-version artifacts and all-or-nothing signing.

Durable retry_media is complete in migrations00149–00152 and scheduler code: exact bulk command intake, recovery-safe lease, deterministic four-variant plan, immutable params, fenced task materialization and canonical attempt/fence adoption into photo.derivatives. Live PostgreSQL integration covers replay and forged-event refusal.

Migrations00153/00156 add explicit ingest and apply origins without weakening bulk snapshot provenance. Accepted first-party ingest versions and owner-accepted Apply versions atomically enqueue thumbnail and preview families; claim revalidates exact origin run kind, accepted version and live verified asset. The origin-aware finalizer publishes all four exact canonical/fenced artifacts without touching bulk accounting. Pending-review versions remain gated. Broker/MinIO crash-boundary execution and RAW camera corpus remain to verify; P06 remains in progress.

UP01 is live-verified with concurrent Service.Begin calls against the same locked tenant_usage row at a one-file quota boundary. The losing transaction creates no multipart side effect; the winning reservation is released exactly once on abort.

UP02 is live-verified across PostgreSQL and versioned MinIO. A pre-complete failure releases the lease and retries the multipart completion; a lost successful response recovers the pinned latest version, verifies every byte, and performs one SQL adoption. Migration00169 qualifies tenant_usage in claim_upload_completion so its OUT tenant_id cannot shadow the table column.

UP03 now binds detected magic to the frozen safe suffix: JPEG/PNG/TIFF/RAW bytes cannot be accepted under another declared format. Adversarial tests cover spoof/SVG, CMYK, multipage, pixel bombs and missing ICC before staging. Together with live UP01/UP02, media profiles and live GC fencing, P06 meets its package completion criteria.
